question: A customer buys Rs 1,250 of items, pays Rs 100 shipping and has a 10% code. How many loyalty points do they earn, and how many rupees make one point (e.g. 1 point per Rs 100)?
A customer's order of Rs 199 earns points at 1 per Rs 100: do they get 1 point (rounded down) or 2 (rounded up)?
An order is paid fully with store credit, or is a final-sale order: does the customer still earn loyalty points on it?
A customer's order is later refunded in full: do the points they earned from it get taken back?
Yesterday we had 3 orders totalling Rs 1,000 (average Rs 333.33). Should the average be rounded to the nearest rupee (333), always down, or always up?
Yesterday one customer cancelled an order worth Rs 800 before it shipped and another was fully refunded Rs 500. Should the daily revenue still count these orders?
Should the daily revenue include shipping fees (e.g. Rs 50 on a Rs 800 order) or only the item amount after discount?
A customer returns a Rs 1,000 order that had Rs 50 shipping because the item was damaged. Do we refund the Rs 50 shipping too, or only the Rs 1,000 for items?
A customer who paid with store credit asks for a refund of Rs 770. Does it go back to store credit, or can they get it on a card?
A changed-mind refund on an order with a 10% discount code: items Rs 800, discount Rs 80. Do we refund Rs 720 (what they actually paid for items) or Rs 800?
Customer asks for a refund with a negative or missing number of days since delivery (e.g. -2 days, or not delivered yet). What do we do?

A customer who bought Rs 1,000 of items changes their mind and returns the order 7 days after delivery. Up to how many days after delivery do we accept a changed-your-mind refund? A) 7 days, so day 7 is fine and day 8 is not  B) 14 days  C) something else (please say)
A customer reports a damaged item 45 days after delivery. Up to how many days after delivery do we accept a damaged-item refund? A) 30 days  B) no time limit  C) something else (please say)
A customer returns a Rs 1,000 order with Rs 50 shipping because they changed their mind. Do we refund the Rs 50 shipping? A) No, only Rs 1,000  B) Yes, Rs 1,050
A customer returns a final-sale Rs 500 clearance shirt because it arrived damaged. Do we refund it? A) No, final sale is never refundable  B) Yes, damaged items are always refunded

A customer asks for a Rs 800 refund 3 days after delivery and gives a reason we do not list, such as wrong colour, or leaves the reason blank. What do we do? A) refund as for changed mind (Rs 800 within the changed-mind window)  B) refund fully as for damaged  C) no refund
